reviewed_by: Claude review of chat conversation archiving
reason: PATCH /chat-sessions/{id} accepts archived true/false (metadata.archived_at; title optional, empty patch rejected) and forks drop the archived state. The conversation menu gains Archive/Unarchive and archived chats move into a collapsed Archived group. Selected tests cover the API archive/unarchive/validation flow in test_chat_api.py, the client mapping in client.test.ts, the rename/archive/unarchive/delete journey in App.test.tsx, and the conversations sidebar Playwright area.
exclusions: No full suites. Chat turns, harness runtimes and message storage are unchanged; other metadata writers already merge existing keys so archived_at is preserved. No LAN-origin check: no origin, cookie or socket behavior changed.
